ranked.headline: Coarse and learned representations replace atomic detail in biomolecular prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report binding affinity and structure models built on coarse pocket, screening-derived, or geometric priors rather than full atomic input.

ranked.headline: ML models predict metabolite, peptide and enzyme properties from spectra and sequence
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply transfer learning, geometric deep learning and standardized benchmarks to metabolite, peptide and enzyme prediction.

ranked.headline: Encoding regulatory and spatial structure in single-cell expression models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers embed DNA regulation, spatial geometry, and chromatin structure directly into models of single-cell and spatial expression.

ranked.headline: Computational tools turn microbial sequence and spectra into validated biological calls
ranked.summary: Amplicon error correction and reference-based profiling are being benchmarked alongside deployable, containerized workflows for pathogen genomics.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer tissue domains and cell-type architecture from spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair deep learning with multiplexed imaging, spatial transcriptomics, and multi-omics integration to resolve tissue-level organization.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata and portable packaging make public omics data queryable
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous public omics records need standardized, queryable metadata before cross-study reuse becomes practical.

ranked.headline: Viral genomics tools model sequencing error and haplotype structure in long-read data
ranked.summary: Pandemic-scale viral datasets and long-read sequencing make explicit error modeling central to phylogenetic and haplotype inference.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide sequences infer admixture, recombination histories and population variation
ranked.summary: Ancestral recombination graph tooling reached a stable 1.0 release, and transformer embeddings now target population structure and ancestry retrieval from…

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of noncoding variants to regulatory function and gene expression
ranked.summary: Population-scale QTL and deep-learning frameworks now link noncoding variants to chromatin states and disease genes across tissues and ancestries.

ranked.headline: Language models predict protein structure similarity and influenza antigenic change
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend biological language models to structural search, tokenization efficiency, genomic chunking and influenza antigenic forecasting.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines extract more identifications from mass spectrometry omics data
ranked.summary: Deep learning and FDR-controlled scoring now underpin peptide, metabolite and cross-link identification across DIA, DDA and SLIM-based MS data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models couple molecular kinetics to cell and system-scale behavior
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method extend mechanistic models from molecular interactions to cell fate, pain signaling, and metabolic homeostasis.

ranked.headline: Models encoding haplotype, chromatin, and evolutionary structure applied to single-cell…
ranked.summary: Single-cell cancer genomes at 86,239-cell scale and standard-depth cfDNA WGS now support inference models built on explicit biological structure.

ranked.headline: Interpretable probes expose learned organization in protein, RNA and drug models
ranked.summary: Pretrained biological models are now being dissected mechanistically, with circuit tracing and subnetwork probing in ESM2-based work.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link lineage-specific gene evolution to transposons and gene loss
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies in myxozoans, Hydra, ants and turtles now resolve lineage-specific gene evolution using comparative methods.

ranked.headline: ML on harmonized patient single-cell atlases nominates targets and cell states
ranked.summary: Harmonized atlases of 1 million intestinal cells, 366 SLE samples, and 186,123 hematopoietic progenitors now couple to ML ranking and lineage models.

ranked.headline: Generative evolutionary models as inferential tools for protein structure and constraint
ranked.summary: Preprints now test mechanistic evolution models against synthetic and alignment-level data to infer protein structure.

ranked.headline: Simulation software spans epidemic, neural and molecular trajectory analysis
ranked.summary: Packaged simulators and trajectory tools for epidemics, neural networks and molecular dynamics now appear in preprints and one publication.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve binding, gating and fusion pathways via enhanced sampling
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and docking simulations now resolve receptor-ligand, channel-gating and membrane-fusion energetics.

ranked.headline: Interaction structure shapes outcomes in game, gene-circuit, and tumor evolution models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show that stochastic game switching, host-circuit coupling, and resource competition each make outcomes depend on interaction rules.

ranked.headline: Language interfaces and enrichment tools make omics and biochemical data queryable
ranked.summary: Three February 2026 preprints add natural-language, integration, and annotation layers to large omics and biochemical data workflows.

ranked.headline: Statistical tools for power, meta-analysis, batch effects and DE testing in omics
ranked.summary: Recent work tightens sample-size planning, meta-analysis error control, batch assessment and spatial DE testing for expression data.

ranked.headline: Compressed and learned feature spaces guide cryo-EM particle classification and curation
ranked.summary: Recent work adds PCA-compressed alignment, point cloud deformation filtering, and a large machine learning RNA motif benchmark for cryo-EM.

ranked.headline: ML and sequencing workflows predict pathogen drug resistance and species identity
ranked.summary: Nanopore pipelines, interpretable models and curated benchmarks are now being applied to bacterial and mycobacterial resistance and identification.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer molecular and temporal states from omics and clinical measurements
ranked.summary: Recent studies test supervised predictors of age, circadian time, and post-mortem interval against independent validation cohorts.

ranked.headline: Computational models of splicing and isoform regulation from sequence and long reads
ranked.summary: Deep learning and long-read tools now predict splice sites, resolve isoform structures, and prioritize expression and splicing variants from RNA data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in raw scRNA-seq data for annotation, trajectory and regulatory…
ranked.summary: Benchmarks like scBench now verify agent recovery of key biological results, making evidence-grounded evaluation of single-cell LLM agents testable.

ranked.headline: Computational tools extract spatial and dynamic features from structural biology data
ranked.summary: New analysis frameworks extract interpretable features from Hi-C, molecular dynamics, and cryo-electron tomography data.

ranked.headline: Validation and leakage control reshape performance claims in predictive biology models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints audit leakage in published drug response methods and propose perturbation and inference checks for siRNA and synergy models.

ranked.headline: New tools infer population size, merge DNA motifs, and model microbiome disease risk
ranked.summary: Recent tools target sparse, redundant, and compositional data that constrain quantitative inference from sequence and sample features.

ranked.headline: Graph-based scores infer multi-way enhancer hubs and uncorrelated regulatory links
ranked.summary: Correlation-based inference misses nonlinear causal links and multi-way enhancer hubs; three new preprints address both with explicit models.

ranked.headline: Integrating multi-source evidence to prioritize genes for disease and metabolic discovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints combine network prediction, LLM literature mining, and co-essentiality mapping to prioritize genes.

ranked.headline: Noise-robust fMRI connectivity from short scans and open epilepsy connectome data
ranked.summary: Short-scan fMRI connectivity methods and open epilepsy connectome releases address robustness and data access for MRI-based connectivity analysis.

ranked.headline: Faster phylogenetic placement, graph alignment, and admixture inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target runtime bottlenecks in phylogenetic placement, graph alignment and admixture estimation at biobank scale.

ranked.headline: Structure-based methods predict kinase selectivity and prioritize synthesized inhibitors
ranked.summary: Kinome-scale reorganization energetics and active-learning docking now connect structure-based prediction directly to synthesized, testable compounds.

ranked.headline: Simulations map pH-dependent LNP-siRNA structure and proposed endosomal escape
ranked.summary: Multiscale and atomistic simulations now resolve pH-dependent LNP-siRNA structure, PNPLA membrane binding, and PET hydrolase energetics.

ranked.headline: AI methods target protein delivery vehicles, de novo design, and drug discovery tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply AI, protein language model embeddings, and Ising-machine encodings to protein engineering and drug discovery problems.
